info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Magenta Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Magenta Jacket Details Management API enables users to seamlessly add detailed information about the Magenta Jacket to the catalog. This endpoint supports the inclusion of characteristics such as size, color, material, and pricing. Ideal for e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems, this API allows businesses to keep their product details up-to-date and accurately reflect their offerings. Typical consumers include online retailers, product managers, and inventory specialists seeking to enhance their catalog visibility and performance.

post.summary: Create new details for a magenta jacket
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new detail entries for a magenta jacket. It expects a payload that includes all necessary attributes to define the jacket's specifications and features.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details related to the magenta jacket. It is expected to contain the specifics of the jacket including attributes like size, style, and any other relevant details that need to be processed.
